result.instructions: Tools for Grafana, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our dashboards mention the checkout service?"; "Show the CPU panel data for the api-gateway dashboard for the last 6 hours."; "Which alert rules are in the production folder?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Grafana data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run grafana_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run grafana_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run grafana_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. grafana_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: grafana_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the signed-in user
tools.description: Return the user or service account behind the token: id, login, name, the current orgId and the Grafana admin flag. Use it to check which token is in use. Grafana API: GET /api/user.

tools.name: grafana_get_current_org
tools.title: Get the current organization
tools.description: Return the organization the token belongs to: id, name and address. Grafana API: GET /api/org.

tools.name: grafana_search
tools.title: Search dashboards and folders
tools.description: Search dashboards and folders by title, tag or folder. Each result has uid, title, type, url and folderUid. Good first call to find a dashboard uid. Grafana API: GET /api/search.

query.description: Text to match in the title.

tag.description: Only items with all these tags.

folder_uids.description: Only items in these folder uids.

tools.name: grafana_get_dashboard
tools.title: Get a dashboard
tools.description: Return one dashboard by uid: its JSON model (panels, queries, variables) and metadata (version, folder, updated). Large dashboards return a large result. Grafana API: GET /api/dashboards/uid/{uid}.

uid.description: The Grafana uid (from a search or list tool).

tools.name: grafana_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List dashboard folders: uid, title and url. Use parent_uid to list nested folders. Grafana API: GET /api/folders.

parent_uid.description: List only the children of this folder uid.

tools.name: grafana_list_datasources
tools.title: List data sources
tools.description: List the data sources of the stack: uid, name, type (for example prometheus or loki) and default flag. Use a uid with grafana_query_data. Grafana API: GET /api/datasources.

tools.name: grafana_get_datasource
tools.title: Get a data source
tools.description: Return one data source by uid: name, type, url and settings (secrets are not returned). Grafana API: GET /api/datasources/uid/{uid}.

uid.description: The Grafana uid (from a search or list tool).

tools.name: grafana_query_data
tools.title: Query data sources
tools.description: Run one or more queries against data sources (metrics, logs, traces) and return the frames. Each query names its datasource uid and the query text for that type, for example {refId, datasource:{uid}, expr} for Prometheus. Grafana API: POST /api/ds/query.

refId.description: Query id, unique in the request. Default: A, B, C in order.

datasource.description: The data source uid, from grafana_list_datasources.

queries.description: Query objects. Each needs datasource: {uid}; add the type's query field, for example expr for Prometheus.

from.description: Start time: epoch ms or a relative time such as now-6h.

to.description: End time: epoch ms or a relative time such as now.

tools.name: grafana_list_org_users
tools.title: List organization users
tools.description: List users and their roles in the current organization. Filter by text with query. Grafana API: GET /api/org/users.

query.description: Match on login, email or name.

tools.name: grafana_list_teams
tools.title: Search teams
tools.description: Search teams by name: id, uid, name, memberCount and email. Grafana API: GET /api/teams/search.

query.description: Text to match in the team name.

tools.name: grafana_list_annotations
tools.title: List annotations
tools.description: List annotations (events on graphs) in a time range, optionally for one dashboard or tag. Times are epoch ms. Grafana API: GET /api/annotations.

dashboard_uid.description: Only annotations of this dashboard uid.

type.description: annotation = manual events, alert = alert state changes.

tools.name: grafana_create_annotation
tools.title: Create an annotation
tools.description: Add an event to a dashboard or to the stack: text, time, optional end time, tags and an optional dashboard uid and panel id. Writes data. Grafana API: POST /api/annotations.

time_end.description: End time, epoch ms (for a range).

panel_id.description: Attach to this panel id (needs dashboard_uid).

tools.name: grafana_list_alert_rules
tools.title: List alert rules
tools.description: List all alert rules of the stack with uid, title, folder, rule group, condition and labels. Grafana API: GET /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Grafana
prompts.description: What you can do with Grafana here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_a_dashboard_and_read_its_panels
prompts.title: Find a dashboard and read its panels
prompts.description: Search dashboards and folders by title or tag. Open one dashboard by its uid to read its panels, queries and variables.

prompts.name: run_a_metrics_or_log_query
prompts.title: Run a metrics or log query
prompts.description: List the data sources to find a uid. Run a query against one data source, for example Prometheus or Loki.

prompts.name: review_alert_rules_by_folder
prompts.title: Review alert rules by folder
prompts.description: List the folders to find one. List the alert rules of the stack with their folder, rule group and condition.

prompts.name: add_a_deploy_marker_to_a_dashboard
prompts.title: Add a deploy marker to a dashboard
prompts.description: List the annotations of a dashboard in a time range. Add an annotation with its text, time and tags.

prompts.name: check_the_token_owner_and_team_members
prompts.title: Check the token owner and team members
prompts.description: Read the user behind the token and the organization. List the teams and the organization users with their roles.
